note: Wooded loops on the west shore of Laurel River Lake, two miles north of the dam, beside Holly Bay Marina; a boat ramp inside the campground is for registered campers. The Sheltowee Trace runs between the loops and the shore. Operated by a concessionaire. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the FS page (updated 2026-10-19) and rec.gov: $46 single/$92 double, 50% Senior/Access on singles, 75 drive-in sites with 30/50A + water, back-in pads to 90 ft, flush toilets/showers/dump, season Apr 9-Oct 19 (closed for the season now), rec.gov booking with first-come for unreserved sites. Lakefront fails: every site sits 50-120 m from the water under continuous forest with the Sheltowee Trace between; propose lakeview. Pin ~278 m off the site centroid.
flags: WATERFRONT DOWNGRADE (stored lakefront, set by --Claude, not --AWH): propose lakeview. rec.gov tags 51 of 70 sites 'Proximity to Water: Lakefront', but the tag is loose (it includes A-7, ~120 m from the water). Plotting the 70 rec.gov site coordinates on Esri imagery, the closest pads are G-4 (36.98325,-84.26657) and G-5 (36.98336,-84.26689) at ~60 m from the high-water line; D-D04 (36.98188,-84.26273) and D-D05 at ~75 m; E-E4 (36.97977,-84.26214) and E-E5 (36.97969,-84.26178) at ~60-75 m; F-F4/F-F5 farther; H-H08 (36.98432,-84.26919) ~70 m. All of that ground is continuous closed canopy on a cliff-lined shore. The official campground map shows the Sheltowee Trace (a used trail) running between the G/D loops and the lake, and the guide says 'wooded sites near the lakeshore'. rec.gov's own text says 'Several campsites provide scenic views overlooking the lake'. Preview photos of D04, D05, E4, E5, F4 and F8 show wooded pads with at most a filtered glimpse. No pad is within ~50 m over open ground, so not lakefront; the official wording supports lakeview. The stored note already said 'none directly on the shore'.

PIN: stored 36.9791667,-84.2666667 is at the south end by A-1/the entrance road, ~278 m from the centroid of the 70 rec.gov site coordinates, 36.98132,-84.26508 (between loops A and D). Propose moving it there. The FS page gives 36.98224853,-84.26665297 (beside loop G).
